card.name: Vivo and vitro after "in"
card.fires_on: The words "vivo" or "vitro" right after "in" in mutagenicity and toxicology test descriptions, such as in vivo mouse micronucleus or in vitro chromosome aberration assay.

modes.label: in vivo
modes.description: The word vivo after "in" when naming animal tests of genetic damage.
modes.example: Results in the in<< vivo>> mouse micronucleus test were also negative

modes.label: in vitro
modes.description: The word vitro after "in" when naming cell-based assays.
modes.example: an in<< vitro>> chromosome aberration assay with human lymphocytes

card.writes: No clear link to the promoted and suppressed tokens; it does not obviously shape the next word.
card.plain: It spots the second half of "in vivo" or "in vitro" in lab-test descriptions of mutagenicity.
